caption:
"Won't automated texts feel like spam?"

That's the question we hear most right before an owner turns on automated follow-up.

The fear is fair. You've gotten the three-times-a-day texts from a lot you never asked to hear from.

Relevance and consent decide the line.

Three fixes that keep it on the right side of that line:

1. Ask permission at the point of capture, not after you've already texted.
2. Put "Reply STOP to opt out" on message one.
3. Cap frequency and stay inside business hours.

Get those right and the lead feels speed.

rationale: Carousels still lead saves/depth for B2B objection content, and this resolves a genuinely unclaimed spam/compliance fear (consent, opt-out, frequency) distinct from every prior cost, impersonal, sales-trap, lock-in, and complexity objection already shipped.
